label: V26 Act 5
_why_this_file_exists: Riot publishes no public API for the competitive map rotation. valorant-api.com's
/v1/maps carries no in-rotation flag (premierBackgroundImage is set on every standard
map, so it can't stand in for one), and /v1/gamemodes/queues describes the Competitive
queue as having a 'limited map pool' without ever listing it. So this list is curated.
The app fetches this file once on load and matches names case-insensitively against the
live map list; names that don't match any map are ignored with a console warning, so a
stale entry degrades quietly rather than breaking the button.
The rotation changes roughly every act. To update: edit `maps`, bump `label`, `patch`
and `updated`. The label is shown in the UI (the RANKED POOL badge's tooltip and the
button's tooltip), so a list that has gone stale is visible rather than silently wrong.
